Titles.eng: BanG Dream! Episode of Roselia II: Song I am.
Titles.jpn: 劇場版 BanG Dream! Episode of Roselia II : Song I am.

Summaries.eng: The members of Roselia who vowed to participate in FUTURE WORLD FES. After overcoming her various trials of becoming "us" with five people. And the season has reached autumn. Lisa grew up after writing the lyrics for "Promise". Yukina and Saya go out to hunt for autumn leaves and write a picture letter of determination to themselves in the future. Rinko tries to write a new song, driven by the desire to do something for Roselia. "The remaining quests are contests and tournaments ... FUTURE WORLD FES ...." Ako suddenly becomes anxious as she begins to think about her goals. What is the scenery seen by the five people ahead of FUTURE WORLD FES.
Summaries.jpn:
私たちは5人で「私たち」になる
さまざまな試練を乗り越え、
FUTURE WORLD FES.への出場を誓ったRoseliaのメンバーたち。
そして、季節は秋を迎えた。

「約束」の作詞を経て成長したリサ。

紅葉狩りに出かけ、未来の自分たちへ決意の絵手紙をしたためる友希那と紗夜。

Roseliaのために何かしたいという思いに突き動かされ、新曲を作ろうとする燐子。

「残るクエストは、コンテストと大会と……FUTURE WORLD FES.……」
自分たちのゴールを考えはじめ、ふと不安になるあこ。

FUTURE WORLD FES.の先に5人が見た景色とは――。
